subject.title: Make Google Chat DM thread sessions configurable

question: Should OpenClaw accept `channels.googlechat.threadSessions` plus the `parentPeer` inbound-envelope helper extension as the public shape for Google Chat thread-scoped DM sessions?
rationale: The implementation is plausible, but both the channel config key and SDK helper signature become public surfaces and overlap with another open Google Chat thread-session PR.

options.title: Accept After Proof And Baselines
options.body: Approve this public shape, then require current-head Google Chat proof, regenerated config/SDK baseline hashes, and conflict resolution before merge.

options.title: Rename Or Consolidate Shape
options.body: Ask the author to align naming/API shape with the older `sessionThread` PR or a maintainer-chosen thread-session contract before merge.

options.title: Pause For Broader Thread Plan
options.body: Hold this PR and centralize the Google Chat thread-session decision in the broader related work instead of landing parallel option names.

recommendation.title: Accept After Proof And Baselines
recommendation.body: Approve this public shape, then require current-head Google Chat proof, regenerated config/SDK baseline hashes, and conflict resolution before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest history across the plugin SDK routing and Google Chat channel boundaries touched by this public-shape decision.
